lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic Tb4Ni2C6 structure (reduced formula Tb2NiC3) crystallizes in space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies carbon-centered octahedra with five Ni and one Tb neighbor, while Ni centers have four C neighbors and Tb centers have six C neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between C-centered octahedra and edge-sharing between Tb-centered six-vertex polyhedra.
